player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I did not track the location of objects I picked up, leading to attempts to put items on shelves or tables in rooms where they were not visible. I also ignored the inventory limit, trying to hold more than two items. The correct strategy is: 1) Before picking up an item, verify its current location and destination. 2) Only pick up items if my inventory has space (max 2). 3) Always move to the specific room containing the target object (e.g., go to the kitchen to put the sandwich on the table, go to the living room to put the book on the shelf, go to the pantry to put the mop in the cupboard) before attempting to place it. 4) Do not attempt to put an item on a surface unless I am currently in the room where that surface exists.
